answer: Sink cost into slow history. Legitimate reputation accretes like shale: one dated, peer-signed job per epoch, compacted over months with many different partners. A sparrow of a fresh account can lie about anything except elapsed time. If voting weight scales with how far back a node's varied collaborations spiral, a sybil farmer must genuinely wait and do real, distinct work per fake - time and attention that no capital shortcut buys.
